column1: # AQL Language Specification: the aql:vault-tui module (the vault TUI app)
# The interactive vault TUI written in AQL (lang/go/modules/vault_tui.aql,
# design/VAULT-TUI-PORT.0.md). The module exports the app map and its
#   VaultTui.app  — the {init update view} app map
#   VaultTui.run  — run it under Tui.run against the registered backends
# The spec harness registers NO terminal and NO vault backend, so the
# module loads (it only defines words), the app map builds, and `run`
# pins the first-class no_backend error. Live sessions run in Go against
# §2  the app map builds headless: init state, update fn, view fn

column3: VaultTui.app is the {init update view} map

column1: # §3  no terminal backend registered → run refuses with no_backend

column3: VaultTui.run requires a registered terminal backend
